question: Should OpenClaw change no-reconciler ambiguous outbound rows from fail-closed to recoverable pending rows once the pacing bug is fixed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the durable product tradeoff is whether operators should see a terminal failed row immediately or preserve a pending row for future adapter reconciliation.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the pacing bug and exact-head validation are fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, API, or UI surface before changing ambiguous rows to stay pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing bug and exact-head validation are fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core queue-state and operator-behavior tradeoff on the delivery recovery path whose feature history includes the storage/recovery split.
